title: S.M. Wright Parkway
text:
Demolition of the S.M. Wright Freeway (originally called South Central Expressway) took place between 2021 and 2023. The new boulevard street was completed in 2025. In February 2026 the Texas Transportation Commission approved a minute order to transfer the roadway to the City of Dallas for jurisdiction, control and maintenance.

As of March 2026, I cannot find any reports of an official dedication ceremony for the S.M. Wright boulevard.

These photos start at US 175 (at SH 310) and proceed northward.

images.caption: The freeway is gone, but the sign remains as of February 2026. This sign is immediately north of US 175.
Close view of the architectural monument at Pine Street

There is a four-way stop at Warren Avenue. It is unexpected to have a stop sign on the street, especially since all other intersections are signalized. I'm assuming this will be replaced with a traffic signal in the future when traffic increases.
Looking north with the Pennsylvania Avenue intersection ahead.
Looking south toward the Pennsylvania Avenue intersection.
S.M. Wright freeway originally went underneath MLK Blvd.
